terrainDescription.zh: 多山地形，氣候較周邊島嶼乾燥，尤加利樹疏林與稀樹草原景觀是與鄰近濕熱雨林地帶明顯不同之處
terrainDescription.en: Mountainous, with a notably drier climate than its neighbors — eucalyptus woodland and savanna-like vegetation stand out against the wetter rainforests typical of the rest of maritime Southeast Asia

historicalContext.zh: 曾為葡萄牙殖民地（靠右行駛），1975年印尼佔領期間改為靠左行駛，2002年獨立後沿用至今；葡萄牙語與泰頓語並列官方語言，是東南亞少見的葡語系國家。
historicalContext.en: A former Portuguese colony (originally right-hand traffic); switched to left-hand traffic during the 1975 Indonesian occupation and kept it after independence in 2002. Portuguese and Tetum are co-official — a rare Lusophone outlier in Southeast Asia.
